title: Samsung DV6000 dryer — Error Recall
description: Display last detected error on DVE(G)45T6200/6000/6005 models.

steps.title: Error Recall mode
steps.body: Press and hold Dryness + Wrinkle Prevent for 8 seconds. Last error code displays; nothing shown if no error stored.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and hold Dryness + Wrinkle Prevent for 8 seconds. Last error code displays; nothing shown if no error stored.
